verdict.rationale: v0 offers a platform API that authenticates with a V0_API_KEY or Vercel OIDC, so issuing credentials is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows scoped, least-privilege, or per-agent API keys with restricted permissions. Secure environment-variable storage is about app secrets, not issuing scoped v0 credentials, and Vercel OIDC is a host-platform mechanism, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
